name: Long March 8A
location_str: Commercial LC-1 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
slot_a_text: Commercial LC-1 has flown 15 launches since its first in 2025, 9 of them this year. The pad had 31 days to reset after the last one.
slot_b_text: The 51st launch of the year for China's CASC, 621st all time. It works out to a launch every six days. Worldwide, it is attempt number 251 of the year.
rocket_fact: Hypergolic propellants ignite automatically when they come into contact, making them useful for spacecraft engines that need reliable starts and restarts.
